detail.command: cd src/courses/data && for f in *.ts; do if [ $f != layoutKit.ts ]; then printf '%-24s md5=%s surfaces=%s cupX=' $f $(grep -o 'size: {[^}]*}' $f | sort | md5 | cut -c1-10) $(grep -c shape: $f); grep -o 'cup: { position: { x: [-0-9.]*' $f | sed 's/.*x: //' | tr '\n' ' '; echo; fi; done; echo; echo LAYOUTKIT_USERS:; grep -l layoutKit *.ts
